description: This file defines the 'GeoZone' controller for the OpenCart admin panel. It handles CRUD operations, listing, and rendering views related to geographic zones within the localization module.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Controller class for managing geographic zones in the admin panel, providing functions for listing, creating, editing, and deleting geo zones.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and displays the main geo zone list page, setting up necessary data and views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to display the list of geo zones by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches geo zone data from the model, handles sorting, pagination, and renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a geo zone, populating data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to add or update geo zone data, returning JSON status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected geo zones after permission and dependency checks, returning JSON status.
